eligibility.explanation: Original mouse experiments used mRNA-LNPs with a reported lipid-class composition. eGFP mRNA-LNP evidence identifies hepatocytes as transfected cells, and HGF mRNA-LNP evidence reports hepatocyte proliferation; both are linked to the reported LNP formulation. Exact lipid identities and component ratios are not reported.
